en: Leaving Lanzhou: Connect the Next Gansu Leg
zh: 离开兰州：把甘肃下一程接好
ja: 蘭州を出る：甘粛の次の行程につなぐ

p.src: Before leaving Lanzhou, write down the one city where you will sleep next. ‘West’ is not an answer. Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiayuguan, and Dunhuang do not belong in a single-day itinerary. Name only the city where you have booked a room or are ready to do so. Ask whether local transport still runs after arrival, whether the property will check you in at that hour, and whether the first plan next morning needs a reservation. If one answer is missing, the overnight plan is incomplete. In the figure, the four guides bring the ticket, identification, bags, and route notebook together for one final check. Find a bookable service, read the printed departure station, and only then decide whether there is time for one last meal or stop in Lanzhou. If the next lodging is not settled, do not add another attraction to the last afternoon.

caption.zh: 四位向导先把下一夜住宿地、订单上的出发点、行李位置和离开住处的时刻放到同一张桌上。
caption.ja: 四人は次の宿泊地、予約に記載された出発地、荷物の場所、宿を出る時刻を同じ卓上で確認する。
caption.en: The four guides put the next overnight city, departure point on the booking, bag location, and hotel leaving time on one table.

p.src: The diagram runs left to right in departure order, but build the plan from the right. Open your valid 12306 or airline booking and read the departure point exactly: Lanzhou West, Lanzhou Station, or Zhongchuan Airport T3. Do not infer it from train type, direction of travel, or the word ‘airport’. Then work backward, allowing time to find the way inside, complete identity and ticket checks or security, wait, and collect bags from the hotel. Follow only one lane; the three departure points are not interchangeable. The arrows show sequence, not roads, metro lines, distance, or duration. If the booking, ticket, or same-day official notice changes, start again from the new departure point rather than using the route printed here.

caption.zh: 先选下一夜住宿地，再从有效订单上的兰州西站、兰州站或T3倒推出发。
caption.ja: 次の宿泊地を決め、有効な予約にある蘭州西駅、蘭州駅、T3のいずれかから逆算する。
caption.en: Choose the next overnight city, then work back from Lanzhou West, Lanzhou Station, or T3 as printed on the valid booking.

p.src: Use this plan only when the ticket says Lanzhou West. The broad roof and forecourt help you recognize the station; they do not show a specific entrance. Staying around Qilihe or the west-station area can avoid a cross-city trip after checkout. If you are staying in the central segment, confirm the current route from the hotel and allow time to collect bags and find the way inside. Do not assume every high-speed or westbound train leaves here. For the metro, the operator currently calls the connecting stop Lanzhou West Station North Square; check the entrance and service on the day. Put any final stop on the way from your bags to the station, and cut it entirely if the schedule tightens. At the station, follow the booking and signs. Do not arrive at the forecourt still deciding which city comes next.

ja: らんしゅうにしえききたひろば

caption.zh: 兰州西站的大屋顶和前广场是辨认这座西侧车站的线索；转地铁时要另找“兰州西站北广场”。
caption.ja: 大屋根と駅前広場は蘭州西駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。地下鉄へ移る時は、別の表示名「兰州西站北广场」を探す。
caption.en: The broad roof and forecourt help identify Lanzhou West. For the metro, look separately for Lanzhou West Station North Square.

p.src: West of Lanzhou, the Hexi Corridor cities appear in sequence. They are not a checklist for one day. Historical accounts describe the corridor as a long, narrow passage north of the Qilian Mountains. That geography explains the line of cities, but it does not require a stop in every one. Treat Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiayuguan, and Dunhuang as separate overnight decisions. If you stop in Wuwei, Zhangye, or Jiayuguan, give that city its own arrival, sleep, and visiting time instead of reducing it to a few hours on the way to Dunhuang. Going straight to Dunhuang may avoid one hotel change, but it also means passing the intermediate cities. Choose where to stay after checking the services currently on sale, arrival hour, confirmed lodging, and the next morning's plan. Summer rail capacity changes with demand, so reports of added trains and directions show volatility, not a timetable for your travel date.

p.src: When the ticket says Lanzhou Station, use the eastern rail station. Do not switch to Lanzhou West merely because it appears repeatedly elsewhere in the itinerary. The clock, station frontage, and nearby hills help you recognize the station; they do not identify the entrance, ticket gate, or waiting hall. From Dongfanghong Square, Lanzhou University, or the station area, go straight to Lanzhou Station instead of adding a westward detour. From Qilihe or farther west, write the cross-city leg into your schedule. Leaving the metro and finding the railway entrance are separate wayfinding steps, so do not work backward from the train's departure time alone. If checkout leaves time for a meal, take it on the way from the hotel to the station and keep the option to go straight inside. Do not store bags somewhere that requires a return trip. At the station, follow the booking, 12306, and signs rather than guessing the waiting area from the building's exterior.

caption.zh: 钟面、站房与近山是辨认东侧兰州站的线索；住在西段时，要把向东横穿城市的一段写进路线。
caption.ja: 時計、駅舎、近い山並みは東側の蘭州駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。西側に泊まるなら、東へ市内を横断する区間を旅程に入れる。
caption.en: The clock, station frontage, and nearby hills identify Lanzhou Station on the eastern side of the city. From western lodging, plan the eastbound cross-city transfer.

p.src: When the flight booking says Zhongchuan Airport T3, make T3 the end of the transfer rather than writing only ‘airport’. T3 entered passenger service in 2025, so the T1 and T2 transfer details in a 2014 guide are no longer current. Recheck the airline's terminal information before departure. The airport is not in central Lanzhou, so the final city activity must finish before the confirmed transfer begins. By rail, verify the printed name Zhongchuan Airport East and a service actually on sale. By road, confirm the current pickup point, baggage arrangement, and expected arrival at T3. The hall in the figure shows the terminal's scale; it cannot locate your check-in island or security entrance, or tell you the walking distance. Once there, you still need time for check-in or bag drop, security, finding the gate, and rest. When time is short, remove the river walk and the last meal across town rather than compressing airline procedures.

caption.zh: 中川机场T3只是抵达兰州的第一站，不在市中心；转乘铁路时，还要继续找到“中川机场东”。
caption.ja: 中川空港T3は蘭州で最初に着く場所で、市街中心ではない。鉄道へ乗り継ぐなら、次に「中川机场东」を探す。
caption.en: Zhongchuan Airport T3 is the first arrival point, not central Lanzhou. A rail transfer still requires the next label: Zhongchuan Airport East.

p.src: If you want one more stop after checkout, first write down the three things that cannot move: where you will collect the bags, when you must leave, and the departure point shown on the booking. The stop must fit within the same part of town; it cannot create a new cross-city return. When departing from Lanzhou West with bags in Qilihe or the western segment, stay west instead of returning to Zhongshan Bridge. When departing from Lanzhou Station, do not double back west for the provincial museum. On a T3 day, keep one city meal or short walk only when the transfer margin is clearly sufficient. Give the stop a hard leaving time and keep a direct station- or airport-bound alternative. Skip anything that adds a queue, another bag deposit, a river crossing, or another security check. A seated meal near the hotel, water, and food for the journey are often more useful than a rushed attraction. Leave at the written time.

p.src: Use an airport-area night when a very late arrival makes the city transfer unreasonable, or when an early flight would make a city departure uncomfortably tight. Its purpose is sleep and enough time for airport formalities, not ordinary Lanzhou sightseeing. Before paying, ask the property to confirm the current T3 pickup point, whether booking is required, transfer hours, luggage capacity, and earliest airport run. The words ‘airport transfer’ on a webpage are not enough. Send the flight number and arrival or departure date, then retain the written reply. The empty vehicle in the figure is a reminder to confirm the transfer; it does not establish a driver, frequency, or real pickup point. When the flight time allows an unhurried trip from the city, staying in the existing lodging segment usually avoids one hotel change. After choosing an airport-area night, keep the final evening to dinner, packing, and sleep. Do not return to the city for the Yellow River night view.

caption.zh: 机场附近的一夜只为保住睡眠和时间余量；订房前仍要确认T3上车点、预约方式和最早送机时间。
caption.ja: 空港周辺の一泊は睡眠と時間の余裕を守るためだけに使う。予約前にT3の乗車場所、予約方法、最も早い空港行き送迎の時刻を確かめる。
caption.en: Use one airport-area night only to protect sleep and a time buffer. Before booking, confirm the T3 pickup point, reservation procedure, and earliest transfer to the airport.

p.src: When a train or flight changes, first check whether the departure point on the booking changed too. A different station, terminal, or date means rebuilding the hotel, baggage, and departure plan. Do not gamble on a cross-city transfer to preserve the final attraction. For passengers who need China Railway's priority assistance, the 12306 guidance checked on 23 August 2026 normally asks for an online request at least six hours before departure. Inside six hours, it directs the passenger to request help at the station no later than 60 minutes before departure. A transfer requires a separate request for each leg, and current acceptance and assistance must still be confirmed with 12306 and the station. These timings can change and do not belong in a permanent itinerary. For a cancellation, long delay, or missed connection, deal with the booking through a valid 12306 or airline channel, then tell the next lodging property the revised arrival. Keep identification, essential medicine, a charger, water, and the next lodging address with you; do not put them in stored bags during a final stop.

p.src: Use the route notebook's last page for six lines: next overnight city and lodging contact; date, service number, and printed station or T3; bag location; hotel departure time; station or terminal margin; first item to cut if time runs short. Save the valid booking, next lodging address, and essential contacts for offline use. Check once the night before, then read official notices again on departure day. Do not spend the night refreshing the screen. If a line changes, work back from the departure point on the booking. Never treat a book example or old screenshot as a live booking. Once all six lines are complete, stop adding places. Eat, pack, sleep, and leave at the written time.
